items.text: A GNOME server outage no longer turns the Windows CI build red.
A config reload rebuilds each window once, not once per pane plus one.
A delivery now asks the share's loose agent which build it is even when the copy onto it fails.
An -AppOnly delivery now says which locations kept an old agent beside the new app.
Perf audit-4: 31 more slowdowns confirmed fixed, 18 small new ones filed, no open P0 left.
